description: Moves an existing studio booking (up to 2 times) to a new free time, identified by booking reference and the email used to book. Check free times first with get_studio_slots for the same package and confirm the new time with the user before calling. Not possible less than 24 hours before the current session.

new_start.description: New start time as returned by get_studio_slots (ISO 8601 with offset)

name: reschedule_studio_booking
title: Remarcar sessão de estúdio
